VMC 84-524.1: 1-Time: Apply all fertilizer at planting or 1 month after planting.
VMC 84-524.2: 2-Time: Half at ~45 days, half at ~3 months before canopy closure. Alternative: first dose 3-4 days after planting, second at 3 months.
VMC 84-524.3: 3-Time: First at planting, second after 1-2 months, third at 3-4 months.

VMC 84-947.1: 1-Time: Apply full fertilizer at planting or right after ratoon starts based on soil test.
VMC 84-947.2: 2-Time: Split into two doses at ~1.5 months and ~3 months before canopy closure.
VMC 84-947.3: 3-Time: Split N and K into 3 equal doses at 30, 60, and 90 days after planting.

MAURITIO RC888.2: 2-Time: Basal dose at planting, then top dress around 3 months.
MAURITIO RC888.3: 3-Time: Split nitrogen into 3 doses within first 3-4 months, or at 30, 60, and 90 days after planting.

VMC 84-524.1: 1-Time: Not recommended. Weed pressure can become too high, and glyphosate should be avoided during germination and tillering due to crop sensitivity.
VMC 84-524.2: 2-Time: Acceptable when combined with chemical weeding. Use 2,4-D or Diuron early for safe control.
VMC 84-524.3: 3-Time: Best practice. Combine manual weeding with selective herbicides (2,4-D or Diuron) to keep the field clean and reduce lodging risk.

VMC 84-947.1: 1-Time: Not recommended. A single weeding is not enough for this fast-growing variety.
VMC 84-947.2: 2-Time: Better, but still limited. Weed competition may reduce internode elongation and ratoon strength.
VMC 84-947.3: 3-Time: Strongly recommended. Use pre-emergence spraying plus three manual weedings at 25, 45, and 65 days after planting.

MAURITIO RC888.1: 1-Time: Risky. Weed stress can weaken plant defense and increase leaf scald vulnerability.
MAURITIO RC888.2: 2-Time: Possible, but reduced weeding can increase disease risk.
MAURITIO RC888.3: 3-Time: Best practice. Perform manual weeding at 25, 45, and 65 days after planting to reduce stress and disease outbreaks.

VMC 84-524.1: 1-Time: Only suitable for shallow soils with hardpan underneath; excess plowing may bring up infertile soil.
VMC 84-524.2: 2-Time: Acceptable when spaced 1-2 weeks apart; first pass encourages weed seed sprouting, second pass suppresses weeds.
VMC 84-524.3: 3-Time: Highly recommended with deep passes (8-12 inches or ~50-60 cm with heavy tractors) to improve rooting and lodging resistance.

VMC 84-947.1: 1-Time (Plant Crop): Not recommended due to poor soil preparation and reduced ratooning lifespan.
VMC 84-947.2: 2-Time (Plant Crop): Recommended for new planting to prepare soil thoroughly for multiple ratoon cycles.
VMC 84-947.3: 3-Time (Plant Crop): Best practice for deep soil preparation and stronger long-term ratoon performance.

MAURITIO RC888.1: 1-Time: Risky; can leave stubble and weeds near the surface, increasing disease pressure and weakening crop vigor.
MAURITIO RC888.2: 2-Time: Acceptable if followed by thorough harrowing to clean and condition the soil.
MAURITIO RC888.3: 3-Time: Strongly recommended to bury residues/weeds and improve drainage against waterlogging stress.
